entrees.nom: 1. Ask the original GPT for a rebuild prompt
entrees.description: Demande au GPT d’origine un prompt décrivant son workflow sous forme d’outils MCP. Le prompt distingue lectures et écritures, recense opérations API et formats, et exclut secrets et instructions cachées.
entrees.description_source: Open the original GPT and ask:
entrees.usage:
Write a prompt for ChatGPT Work or Codex to rebuild this workflow as MCP tools. Identify which operations read information and which make changes.

Include the API operation, inputs, returned fields, and answer format. Mark anything you don't know. Leave out credentials, secrets, and hidden instructions.

Ask the builder to reuse the API and explain the connection setup.

entrees.description: Les clients Codex locaux prennent en charge les serveurs MCP STDIO et HTTP streamable, avec jeton Bearer, OAuth ou authentification de session ChatGPT pour les serveurs propriétaires de confiance. Ils lisent aussi le champ `instructions` reçu à l'initialisation ; ces capacités ne garantissent pas celles des outils de plugins hébergés.
entrees.description_source: - STDIO servers: Servers that run as a local process (started by a command). - Environment variables - Streamable HTTP servers: Servers that you access at an address. - Bearer token authentication - OAuth authentication, including Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) and Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) - ChatGPT session authentication for trusted first-party servers - Server instructions: Codex reads the MCP instructions field returned during initialization and uses it as server-wide guidance alongside the server's tools.
